summary: TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID/SECRET are exchanged at <base>/oauth/token for a short-lived bearer kept in memory when no API key is set.
reason: The spec declares only bearer auth; modeling OAuth client_credentials in the spec would disable the plain TAILSCALE_API_KEY bearer path, so the exchange lives in a client hook.
validated_outcome: TestOAuthClientCredentialsMintToken: one exchange, all requests use the minted token.
